prompt: A vintage toy store began the month with an inventory of 250 limited-edition action figures. Mid-month, they received a new shipment that increased their total inventory by 40%. By the end of the month, they had sold 75 of these figures. Unfortunately, during a quality check, it was discovered that exactly one-fifth of the *remaining* action figures were found to be defective and had to be discarded. The store plans to pack the *good* remaining figures into display cases, with each case holding 12 action figures. How many *full* display cases can they prepare?
